timeline.summary: Harsha Vij, promoter of TSF Investments Limited, confirmed no encumbrance on promoter group shares for FY2025-26 or earlier as of 02/04/2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹297.57 Cr (+503.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹161.07 Cr (+50.3% YoY).
TSF Investments Limited’s Board, chaired by **S. Kalyanaraman**, recommended ₹4.45 final dividend per share (89% p.a.) payable by July 24, 2026, to shareholders recorded on July 7, 2026.
TSF Investments reported a consolidated net profit of ₹530.21 Cr for FY26, up 28.66% YoY, and recommended a final dividend of ₹4.45 per share.
TSF Investments approved the sale of its entire 3.74% stake (7,55,682 shares) in TVS Holdings to its promoter group by November 2, 2026.
